The '''Thodians''' were a sentient [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Thodia system/Legends|Thodia system]].

==History==
The Thodians evolved on a planet in the [[Thodia system/Legends|Thodia system]] of [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A member of this species was a swimmer when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] threw [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia's]] comlink into the sea.
